scope: Published scientific task configurations; endpoint credentials are supplied privately. Model aliases may change remotely.

transport.historical_recovery: Kimi/Qwen final recovery used streaming, eight shared API slots and no automatic malformed-stream retry.
transport.equivalence: Participant surfaces, evaluator rules, target and order seeds are matched; transport and host scheduling are not claimed identical.

grading.recovered: Qualified batch evaluator: container per candidate, fresh interpreter per case; 33 candidates/3300 outcomes matched the frozen per-case grader in qualification.
grading.public_regrade: Per-case containers; any discrepancies are reported rather than silently replacing published values.
